info.title: Biho whole-diamond Wallet and Financial Administration
info.description: One spendable whole-diamond wallet per account; held diamonds are reservations, not a second earning balance. JSON int64 integer tokens; clients must preserve exact integers. Financial states are PostgreSQL-authoritative. External payout, fiat conversion and live activity collection remain disabled/unintegrated.

get.description: Live bound session; ordinary reads are scoped to the authenticated account.

200.description: Committed financial result; pending/review states do not report provider settlement.

403.description: Insufficient scoped authority or withdrawal not eligible.

409.description: Conflict, insufficient diamonds, or unconfigured financial workflow.

503.description: Security, audit, financial state, or verified activity unavailable.
